thread:
incident-bot: High severity alert — spike in fallback events from hosted -> dedicated for shard-77 (us-east-1). Symptoms: sudden tokenization errors and wrong-model outputs. Fallback count ~450/min, 5xx rate +18% in last 2m. Potential customer impact: enterprise tenants receiving gibberish or partial failures.

oncall-alex: Taking pager. Opening ephemeral incident channel #inc-1755559999. Maya, can you triage router?

maya_sre: Looking. Initial summary: fallback policy for shard-77 set to 'prefer_dedicated_variant'. Mapping table appears to route hosted v1 -> dedicated v1b (incompatible tokenizer).

sam_engineer: Seeing validation failures in the runtime logs: `tokenizer_mismatch: expected_vocab=50257 got=32000` — requests accepted by the dedicated pool but decoded incorrectly, resulting in corrupted output.

cassie_support: CS: acme and betaworks opened support tickets reporting nonsense/potentially billing-impacting responses. Notified top level CSMs.

lucas_englead: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable auto-fallback for shard-77, 2) force queueing/serve-hosted until mapping fixed, 3) patch router variant mapping. Maya — can you flip the policy?

maya_sre: Applying policy change now. Running: ```rctl policy update shard-77 --fallback-mode=queue --auto-fallback=false``` Pushing... done. Verifying traffic.

incident-bot: Policy update applied by maya_sre at 12:07:23 UTC. Observed fallback events drop from ~450/min to ~12/min within 30s. 5xxs down from 18% -> 6%.

sam_engineer: We need a hotfix for the route-mapper. Current entry: `hosted:redwood-llama-v1 -> dedicated:redwood-llama-v1b` should be identity -> `redwood-llama-v1`. Patch plan: ```PATCH /route-mapping/shard-77 {"from":"v1","to":"v1"}```

oncall-alex: Sam, PR and deploy or keep policy off until safe. Also start tracking customer impact numbers.

sam_engineer: Creating PR now -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/route-mapper/pulls/3245 (WIP).

jordan_prod: Customer impact snapshot: acme ~1200 failed/degraded requests, betaworks ~400. Non-enterprise tenants saw quality degradation but not full failures. Possible SLA credit exposure for acme.

cassie_support: Drafting customer comms. Will hold for 20m to confirm mitigation window. Suggested tone: brief, non-technical, apology + ETA.

lucas_englead: Agreed. Keep it high level. SRE to confirm mitigation start time, CS will send notifications.

maya_sre: Observed routing oscillation earlier: region fallback tried us-west-2 then immediately fell back to us-east-1, creating sticky sessions with wrong cache/variant assignments. Flushed KV for shard-77 to clear stale assignments: ```redis-cli -h kv-shard-77 FLUSHDB``` — done.

sam_engineer: Patch merged to master, initiating canary: ```deploy route-mapper canary --env prod --shard shard-77```

incident-bot: Deploy started by sam_engineer at 12:12:50 UTC. Notifying eng-oncall.

maya_sre: Canary healthy. Variant mapping now consistent; sampled logs show tokenizer errors gone. Rolling to 30%.

oncall-alex: Keep fallback policy disabled until full rollout completes. Creating postmortem ticket and assigning action items: 1) pre-deploy variant mapping validation, 2) fallback guard for tokenizer compatibility, 3) alert tuning for tokenizer mismatch spikes. Assign to Sam, Maya, Lucas.

cassie_support: Sent interim notifications to acme and betaworks (INC-1755559999). Tracking requests for credits.

lucas_englead: Set incident severity to sev=2 given enterprise impact.

sam_engineer: Full rollout complete at 12:25:03 UTC. Errors back to baseline (~0.9%). Tokenizer mismatch resolved. Will keep policy disabled in prod and test guarded auto-fallback in staging for 1h.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated. Time-to-mitigate ~18 minutes. Handing off monitoring to oncall for 2h. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/incidents/variant-fallback

oncall-alex: Monitoring started. If any regression, page eng-oncall immediately. Scheduling RCA review at 15:00.

cassie_support: Customer follow-ups scheduled. Will reopen tickets if they report further issues.

maya_sre: Action items created: RB-324 (pre-deploy validator) -> sam_engineer, RB-325 (fallback tokenizer guard) -> maya_sre, RB-326 (alert tuning) -> maya_sre.

lucas_englead: Postmortem owner: sam_engineer. Include timeline, root cause (stale routing mapping + missing fallback compatibility checks), and remediation plan.

incident-bot: Generated debug log snippet: ```[12:05:11Z] router: fallback_event tenant=acme shard=77 from=hosted:v1 to=dedicated:v1b result=accepted tokenizer_check=false``` ```[12:05:12Z] dedicated-runtime: model_load model=redwood-llama-v1b gpu=gpu-4 tokenizer_check=failed```

end of thread.
